verdict.rationale: Firecrawl offers a hosted cloud service where plan quotas are a fair question, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers monthly credit or request quotas, or what happens when a user exceeds them (overage billing versus a hard cutoff). The community remarks about cost being high do not address overage behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether exceeding my plan's monthly credit or request quota triggers overage charges or a hard cutoff
